annotation.title_clean: Secure Software Development Practices for Generative AI and Dual-Use Foundation Models: An SSDF Community Profile (NIST SP 800-218A)
annotation.title_en: Secure Software Development Practices for Generative AI and Dual-Use Foundation Models: An SSDF Community Profile (NIST SP 800-218A)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST); Booth, H.; Souppaya, M.; Vassilev, A.; Ogata, M.; Stanley, M.; Scarfone, K.
annotation.summary_en: NIST SP 800-218A is an SSDF Community Profile, issued under Executive Order 14110, adding AI-model-specific secure development practices for generative AI and dual-use foundation models to SSDF 1.1. It gives prioritized tasks, recommendations and mappings to the AI RMF and OWASP LLM Top 10. It is voluntary and has no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Augments SSDF 1.1 with AI-specific recommendations, considerations and notes, as a companion to SP 800-218.
Covers AI model development: data sourcing, training, fine-tuning, evaluation and integration. Deployment and operation are out of scope.
Protect model weights, training data and pipelines with least privilege, hashes, signatures and monitoring.
Verify provenance and integrity of training data and acquired models; scan and red-team models for vulnerabilities.
Adopt a risk-based approach with shared responsibility among model producers, system producers and acquirers.
